data.name: The Grand Furnace
data.detailed_description:
Generations come and go without end; the river moon looks the same year after year.
Watched or not, this world lives on.

A world that lives

No single storyline waits for you to follow it, and no NPC stands frozen in place waiting for you to arrive.
Towns keep their own days; the wilds keep their own dangers. The world moves on while you're away - and when you return, it still remembers who you are and what you have done.

People meet, people part; some rise, some fall. Your life is one passage in a living world.

Words carry weight

Promises you make are waited on. Grudges you earn are kept. Deeds you do become rumor.

A helping hand may plant a bond that bears fruit years later; a theft may call down a reckoning just as far away.
Here, speech and deed alike are debts - to people, and to heaven.

A Dao forged by walking

There is no single template for cultivation.

Seek opportunities, learn arts, befriend fellow cultivators - or take risks, seize what you want, kill, and make enemies. However you live is how your Dao grows.

And when you finally reach the gate, heaven will not ask what class you picked or what build you copied - it only looks at who you became along the road.

AI narrates; heaven keeps the books

Narrative and character responses are improvised live by AI, shaped by your choices, your relationships, and the state of the world - so different lives may unfold into entirely different stories.

But the AI is not heaven.

Stats, items, bonds, promises, wounds, causes and consequences are all recorded and judged by the game's deterministic systems.
Fine words can spin a thousand tales - only what truly happened counts.

data.short_description: An AI-narrated xianxia life sim. No fixed script: the world runs on its own, watched or not. Cultivate, forge bonds, make enemies, seek fortune - walk a Dao of your own. Not just you: everyone here leaves a history you may never see. The world is the furnace - live your own xianxia life.

content_descriptors.notes: This is a text-driven wuxia/xianxia (Chinese cultivation fantasy) game. It contains textual depictions of violence: combat, killing, corpses, and dark cultivation practices such as corpse refinement. The story may involve kidnapping and coercive threats as plot elements; sexual assault is never depicted. Contains alcohol use in tavern scenes, crude language and humor, and mild romantic innuendo (no explicit sexual content). Violence is presented through narrative text; the game contains no realistic gore imagery.
